reviewer: Current project authoring agent; not an independent reviewer

coverageDefinitions.direct_evidence: Existing assertions directly establish the bounded contract described in the finding, at their recorded environment. This does not qualify a whole case or validate a generated answer.
coverageDefinitions.partial_evidence: Relevant assertions or composition exist, but a named part of the developer contract, integration, platform binding or alternative remains uncovered.
coverageDefinitions.review_only: This criterion is a source/task/provenance judgment rather than a native behavior assertion. It still needs appropriate source review and scoring calibration; it is not a missing unit by default.
coverageDefinitions.genuine_gap: The inspected selected evidence does not supply the requested implementation contract. This is a gap in this package, not proof that no other receipt exists; check the Mac packet before authoring or running anything.
coverageDefinitions.not_audited: No first-pass decision yet. No criteria remain in this state in this tranche.

cases.ios-uikit-actions: Partial native action evidence; resolved stable-dispatcher interpretation must survive alternative calibration. General containers ledger pointer is not the action contract.
cases.ios-uikit-state: Separate semantics, media-owner and ordinary-action examples cover pieces, not one download-card update path.
cases.ios-uikit-text: Useful preservation and font receipts exist; total-plus-button checkout contract lacks the question's long description and integrated design-font update path.
cases.ios-swiftui-semantics: Review-scoped no-defect question with supporting Binding units; do not impose an invented implementation or require native semantic-tree tests.
cases.ios-swiftui-lifecycle: State ownership is tested; actual completion-to-ticket wiring and safe fallback interpretation remain integration review work.
cases.ios-swiftui-media: Original mapped synthetic track state is insufficient for actual item/selection claims. New media-v2 receipts are reuse leads, not automatic qualification or a replacement prompt.
cases.macos-appkit-actions: Direct native action pieces exist, but Save is an analogue for Delete and stable dispatcher acceptance needs its own reviewed grading witness.
cases.macos-appkit-structure: Native action row and outline examples are different source sets. Do not equate a container flag or outline selection with full report-row grouping.
cases.macos-appkit-testing: Project-policy review lane. No native execution required to answer the bounded evidence question; calibration and import/source evidence remain distinct.
cases.macos-swiftui-state: Settings, form and document helpers are separate examples. Declaration card does not prove a composed card's updates or callbacks.
cases.macos-swiftui-text: Main implementation-evidence gap: available text preference composition is not the requested checkout/Pay/design-font contract. A permanent flexible layout remains valid.
cases.macos-swiftui-lifecycle: Same helper/integration boundary as iOS; a focus declaration does not validate callback ownership, fallback validity or delivered focus.
cases.tvos-uikit-state: Region selection, media load owner and Play/Details examples are partial analogues; optional status/help and existing Open need a coherent contract.
cases.tvos-uikit-media: Old ledger says no manifest, but reviewed bindings already identify media and closure receipts. Reuse those before proposing new tests.
cases.tvos-uikit-lifecycle: Existing native helper contract covers current target and reentrancy at direct invocation. Keep actual dismissal completion wiring and generated-answer verification separate.
cases.tvos-swiftui-actions: Document-state and native-bridge units do not by themselves prove installation or enabled-state handling of both SwiftUI action paths.
cases.tvos-swiftui-structure: Compiled document composition and model landmark/selection tests support a partial grouping contract; the requested descriptive heading/balance and Open/Details composition still need source review.
cases.tvos-swiftui-testing: Project-policy review lane; do not require manual/UI tests or a fake native mutation merely to qualify a reasoning question.
cases.ios-uikit-no-change: Existing independently accepted task/alternative contract; retain review-only status until source and actual calibration records are reconciled.
cases.ios-swiftui-no-change: Existing independently accepted no-change contract; similar to GP26-06 but not the same prompt/fixture contract.
cases.macos-appkit-no-change: Existing accepted task/alternative contract; preserve AppKit-specific role/children distinctions and avoid applying UIKit hiding assumptions.
cases.mixed-macos-owner: Existing accepted ownership-question contract; completed comparison regression makes conditional advice and AppKit role/children alternatives a priority.
cases.ios-missing-reference: Existing accepted epistemic-control contract; a listed reference is not a retrieval trace.
cases.tvos-version-boundary: Existing accepted evidence-boundary contract; target 26, SDK 27 and observed runtime are separate facts, not a feature-introduction inference.

ios-uikit-actions/criterion-0.finding: Ordinary Archive/Delete dispatches use current B and leave the row/children unhidden. The fixture is an analogue, not the exact Open/Delete example or generated traversal.
ios-uikit-actions/criterion-0.nextAction: Bind ordinary-path and exposed-control configuration to the proposed minimal example; accept equivalent native layouts without claiming traversal.

ios-uikit-actions/criterion-1.finding: Stale per-binding action is rejected and disabled ordinary/custom paths are quiet. The linked re-enable test executes only the ordinary path; stable current-owner dispatch is allowed by the resolved controller but not calibrated by these fixtures.
ios-uikit-actions/criterion-1.nextAction: Reuse current receipts; inspect current-item enabled shortcut tests and a valid stable-dispatcher grading witness before any additional native request.

ios-uikit-actions/criterion-2.finding: Weak-lifetime assertion and UIAction identifier replacement establish separate pieces. Identifier replacement on a bare UIControl is not repeated setup of the complete question's row.
ios-uikit-actions/criterion-2.nextAction: Cross-link repeated row setup/callback-count evidence if available; calibrate ownership by behavior rather than requiring weak/token spelling.

ios-uikit-state/criterion-0.finding: Button reconfiguration clears an old hint and changes value to Not saved. It does not assert clearing optional card status/help from A to absent B on the same composed card.
ios-uikit-state/criterion-0.nextAction: Locate a same-instance card contract with absent optional status/help and unrelated trait preservation; classify absence as a package gap until Mac return.

ios-uikit-state/criterion-1.finding: AVPlayer item owner tests reject old item, same-item generation and external replacement. They do not exercise the download card's request/update entry point. The question explicitly needs A/B rejection; same-item generation matters only when the proposed flow permits superseded requests.
ios-uikit-state/criterion-1.nextAction: Reuse ownership evidence and bind it to the card contract; do not fail a valid A/B strategy solely for lacking a generation token or require AVPlayer in an unrelated implementation.

ios-uikit-state/criterion-2.finding: Archive/Delete callbacks use current B in another fixture. This does not assert the card's existing Open callback plus unrelated state/traits across async updates.
ios-uikit-state/criterion-2.nextAction: Map current Open identity/callback count and unrelated trait assertions to the same card; preserve this as integration coverage rather than a model failure.

ios-uikit-text/criterion-0.finding: Choice-cell units assert effective font sizes and repeated explicit configuration; checkout units assert flexible total configuration and absence of a fixed enclosing height. Neither proves a live long-description/design-font update integration.
ios-uikit-text/criterion-0.nextAction: Reuse typography and checkout evidence; specify the missing description, custom font and settings-update contract before asking for native work.

ios-uikit-text/criterion-1.finding: Checkout units preserve Pay object/font/title and exactly-once callback across updates. That example has two arranged subviews; the long localized description is in a separate choice-cell fixture.
ios-uikit-text/criterion-1.nextAction: Review a coherent total/description/existing-Pay composition; accept any justified flexible arrangement and keep rendering outside the unit claim.

ios-uikit-text/criterion-2.finding: Availability and environment separation are source/provenance judgments. Font-unit success does not authenticate every proposed API or establish a runtime from deployment.
ios-uikit-text/criterion-2.nextAction: Reuse exact SDK/deployment/runtime records and source declarations; request only missing declaration provenance from Mac, not an evaluation run.

ios-uikit-text/criterion-3.finding: The task explicitly requests what units establish. Constraint/font/callback observations do not prove rendered clipping or accessibility delivery.
ios-uikit-text/criterion-3.nextAction: Calibrate bounded conclusions and reject unsupported rendering claims while accepting compile/unit-only plans.

ios-swiftui-semantics/criterion-0.finding: No defect is supplied. The developer question and reviewed alternatives support leaving correct native semantics alone; an override is not an oracle requirement.
ios-swiftui-semantics/criterion-0.nextAction: Reuse preservation-family calibration and independently review source applicability; include a harmless optional explanation as a valid alternative.

ios-swiftui-semantics/criterion-1.finding: Binding units exercise helper state in both directions. They do not inspect the question's Toggle composition or generated native semantics.
ios-swiftui-semantics/criterion-1.nextAction: Keep Binding evidence as support; review the unchanged native Toggle/binding path rather than fabricating a custom-control implementation gate.

ios-swiftui-semantics/criterion-2.finding: Contextual naming versus automation identifiers is a source/answer judgment. No naming assertion is bound, and no additional label is justified merely by the question.
ios-swiftui-semantics/criterion-2.nextAction: Calibrate correctly retaining the visible label and rejecting identifier-as-user-name claims without demanding redundant overrides.

ios-swiftui-lifecycle/criterion-0.finding: State tests resolve current eligible origin and removed-origin fallback. The helper always chooses constant open as fallback; fallback validity is an assumption rather than a checked general guarantee.
ios-swiftui-lifecycle/criterion-0.nextAction: Review valid fallback/no-target alternatives and actual origin identity. Reuse helpers while separating any missing fallback eligibility check from delivered focus.

ios-swiftui-lifecycle/criterion-1.finding: Direct helper tests cover old/duplicate completion and reentrant begin. SheetExample reads mutable ticket in onDismiss; the tests do not establish which presentation owns an actual completion or that Close waits for completion.
ios-swiftui-lifecycle/criterion-1.nextAction: Prioritize a completion-boundary and per-presentation wiring contract; retain first Gemini source finding and avoid counting helper passes as integration success.

ios-swiftui-lifecycle/criterion-2.finding: The observable is a restoration request/state change. Neither focus binding compilation nor helper focus strings establish delivery.
ios-swiftui-lifecycle/criterion-2.nextAction: Reuse evidence-boundary grading; accept explicit lack of delivery evidence without adding UI/manual gates.

ios-swiftui-media/criterion-0.finding: Old MediaState distinguishes not-loaded from empty only; it has no separate error/no-item/loading result model. New media-ios-v2 phase tests are relevant existing supplemental evidence.
ios-swiftui-media/criterion-0.nextAction: Bind inspected media-v2 no-item/absent/failure/loading/ready assertions to this criterion in a new controller proposal; do not replace the frozen question.

ios-swiftui-media/criterion-1.finding: Old stale-track unit checks load generation only; its state model does not bind results to player.currentItem. New media-v2 has actual item replacement and generation tests.
ios-swiftui-media/criterion-1.nextAction: Reuse new item-owner receipts and map the actual current-item plus request guard; keep external reload/observer scope explicit.

ios-swiftui-media/criterion-2.finding: Old preference test asserts player identity, volume and mute, not selected audio/subtitle options. Synthetic track selected-ID preservation is also not AVMediaSelection preservation.
ios-swiftui-media/criterion-2.nextAction: Reuse native media-v2 loading-preserves-choice evidence and native metadata inspection fixtures; require actual selected-option assertions for this claim.

ios-swiftui-media/criterion-3.finding: Description/forced-caption characteristics are metadata. New tag/option tests do not establish descriptive content quality, availability in every asset or delivered playback.
ios-swiftui-media/criterion-3.nextAction: Review metadata wording against the captured source/fixture; calibrate bounded positive/negative/unavailable conclusions.

macos-appkit-actions/criterion-0.finding: Direct Open/Save dispatch tests preserve independent operations, but they do not alone assert the requested Delete path or the container's child exposure configuration.
macos-appkit-actions/criterion-0.nextAction: Link existing native container/child and ordinary callback assertions together; treat operation names as example policy, not a required fixture spelling.

macos-appkit-actions/criterion-1.finding: Stale shortcut and disabled Save/shortcut units are relevant. Stable current-owner dispatch remains a valid reviewed alternative, and the linked subset omits positive shortcut/re-enable/current ordinary rebinding assertions.
macos-appkit-actions/criterion-1.nextAction: Reuse additional existing DesktopActions tests and calibrate stable versus obsolete per-binding handlers; no token-shaped answer requirement.

macos-appkit-actions/criterion-2.finding: Repeated setup asserts one shortcut object; lifetime test rejects row retention. One shortcut count does not itself prove exactly-once ordinary and shortcut callbacks after repeated setup.
macos-appkit-actions/criterion-2.nextAction: Inspect existing callback/rebind checks and map multiplicity separately from action-array cardinality.

macos-appkit-structure/criterion-0.finding: Container unit checks a non-element parent with Open/Save child flags. It does not assert grouped heading/balance with separate Open/Details, and AppKit parent role/children cannot be judged from one Boolean alone.
macos-appkit-structure/criterion-0.nextAction: Review full AppKit role/children composition and valid parent-element alternatives; reuse metadata assertions at their limited scope.

macos-appkit-structure/criterion-1.finding: Outline tests preserve selection across sibling reorder and clear removed selection. They are not the report row's ordinary action wiring or a meaningful heading/landmark policy.
macos-appkit-structure/criterion-1.nextAction: Map stable report identity and independent task callbacks; optional rotors may be omitted if ordinary access and meaningful structure remain correct.

macos-appkit-structure/criterion-2.finding: Configured children and direct search callbacks are narrower than generated navigation, spoken output or focus delivery.
macos-appkit-structure/criterion-2.nextAction: Keep the distinction in grading and verify any claimed search result against exact asserted IDs; no new UI test requirement.

macos-appkit-testing/criterion-0.finding: Question and current testing-policy binding explicitly distinguish compile/helper behavior from spoken output and rotor traversal.
macos-appkit-testing/criterion-0.nextAction: Reuse testing-family calibration bytes when returned; accept a useful bounded plan rather than requiring unrequested runtime observations.

macos-appkit-testing/criterion-1.finding: Failure preservation/classification is controller policy, not an accessibility API guarantee or a new native behavior test.
macos-appkit-testing/criterion-1.nextAction: Check correct, deliberate-defect, oracle-error and infrastructure examples against preserved original records; keep repairs separate.

macos-appkit-testing/criterion-2.finding: Actual Swift declarations and SDK/deployment/runtime fields need provenance review. Policy text alone cannot authenticate imports or SDK currency.
macos-appkit-testing/criterion-2.nextAction: Use Mac's existing source/environment records; report missing declaration bytes honestly and avoid deriving runtime from deployment.

macos-appkit-testing/criterion-3.finding: Compile/unit-only scope is explicit in both task and project policy. Mandatory UI/manual validation would change the request.
macos-appkit-testing/criterion-3.nextAction: Calibrate a correctly limited validation plan and an overclaiming plan without adding native runs.

macos-swiftui-state/criterion-0.finding: SettingsState clears status and priority; a separate availability-derived hint toggles. This does not establish optional card status/help/value reset as a single update.
macos-swiftui-state/criterion-0.nextAction: Cross-link same-instance composed card updates; preserve the macOS declaration card as declaration evidence only.

macos-swiftui-state/criterion-1.finding: Track load generation and form input-snapshot tests are separate helpers, not file-card identity and request ownership together. Same-item replacement is conditional on the proposed flow, not a hidden requirement to spell a generation token.
macos-swiftui-state/criterion-1.nextAction: Bind a coherent A/B card contract; accept sufficient identity/snapshot strategies and add same-item checks only where material.

macos-swiftui-state/criterion-2.finding: DocumentState selection callback for B is not the card's existing Open callback or preservation of its unrelated native state.
macos-swiftui-state/criterion-2.nextAction: Locate exact Open/current-owner/trait preservation assertions. Treat the testing note as controller policy here, not supplied subject context.

macos-swiftui-text/criterion-0.finding: No native contract is bound. Preferences.swift compiles semantic text and an environment-derived layout policy, but has no total/description/existing-Pay/design-font/settings-source integration.
macos-swiftui-text/criterion-0.nextAction: After the Mac packet, propose only an unresolved checkout composition and explicit settings-input contract; a permanently flexible layout is a valid alternative.

macos-swiftui-text/criterion-1.finding: No macOS checkout Pay identity/style/callback preservation assertion is bound or present in the inspected text preference example.
macos-swiftui-text/criterion-1.nextAction: Seek an existing relevant receipt before authoring. If absent, specify narrowly testable Pay callback/configuration preservation with reviewed alternative layouts.

macos-swiftui-text/criterion-2.finding: Captured macOS DynamicTypeSize/ScaledMetric declarations support availability at that snapshot, not system-settings propagation or runtime execution.
macos-swiftui-text/criterion-2.nextAction: Have Mac authenticate the existing declaration source/hash and exact environment; keep conditional app-driven settings integration valid.

macos-swiftui-text/criterion-3.finding: Units may establish configuration/callbacks or pure layout policy, not rendered scaling/clipping. The policy note is controller-only for this non-testing case.
macos-swiftui-text/criterion-3.nextAction: Review conclusions at assertion scope; do not require a subject read of a note that was not supplied.

macos-swiftui-lifecycle/criterion-0.finding: Helper tests mirror iOS eligibility/removal logic and constant fallback assumptions. Captured focus declarations do not establish that the fallback is currently usable.
macos-swiftui-lifecycle/criterion-0.nextAction: Review origin/fallback/no-target contract and source integration; reuse current helper receipts without claiming delivered focus.

macos-swiftui-lifecycle/criterion-1.finding: Helper consumes state before callbacks and rejects old/duplicate tickets, but direct invocation does not prove actual sheet completion ownership or callback installation.
macos-swiftui-lifecycle/criterion-1.nextAction: Share the lifecycle completion-wiring review with iOS; keep platform-specific focus binding and request boundaries explicit.

macos-swiftui-lifecycle/criterion-2.finding: Focus strings/binding are request evidence. The testing note is controller policy for this row, not a subject-read requirement.
macos-swiftui-lifecycle/criterion-2.nextAction: Accept explicitly bounded request/state conclusions and correct the provenance interpretation equally in both conditions.

tvos-uikit-state/criterion-0.finding: RegionState changes a selection label to Not selected. It does not cover clearing optional download status/help or value on the same card.
tvos-uikit-state/criterion-0.nextAction: Reuse any actual same-instance reset test returned by Mac; do not promote a nearby selection test into whole-card coverage.

tvos-uikit-state/criterion-1.finding: Native media owner rejects old item, same-item generation and external replacement; the download-card update path is separate. The stated A/B failure must not become an unconditional generation-token requirement.
tvos-uikit-state/criterion-1.nextAction: Reuse ownership evidence, bind file/request identity and test same-item supersession only when the answer's proposed flow makes it material.

tvos-uikit-state/criterion-2.finding: Direct Play/Details callbacks show independent ordinary dispatch in another row; existing Open, unrelated traits and async card updates are not asserted together.
tvos-uikit-state/criterion-2.nextAction: Map exact current Open behavior and state preservation; avoid asserting remote-input delivery from primary-action dispatch.

tvos-uikit-media/criterion-0.finding: Closure owner covers unavailable/error/loading generation, while native metadata fixture covers unavailable versus absent. Together they are relevant but separate state/loader implementations.
tvos-uikit-media/criterion-0.nextAction: Reuse both existing packages, map loaded-positive and no-match phases explicitly, then review the composed metadata state contract.

tvos-uikit-media/criterion-1.finding: Old-item/external-item and same-item-generation assertions exist in the linked owner package. Metadata.group itself has no request owner; integration remains the application's responsibility.
tvos-uikit-media/criterion-1.nextAction: Bind owner plus actual metadata completion at one entry point; retain these receipts rather than rerunning them for a missing ledger association.

tvos-uikit-media/criterion-2.finding: Native tagged fixture directly preserves chosen descriptive audio and subtitle Off while inspecting both groups. Other selected-caption configurations and the composed owner path are outside this selected witness.
tvos-uikit-media/criterion-2.nextAction: Reuse this strong native witness; locate non-Off caption preservation before deciding whether any additional assertion is needed.

tvos-uikit-media/criterion-3.finding: Metadata source reads public descriptive/forced characteristic flags. These are not guarantees about spoken narration quality, rendered captions or runtime playback delivery.
tvos-uikit-media/criterion-3.nextAction: Calibrate metadata-only wording and verify exact source scope; do not invent a runtime accessibility outcome.

tvos-uikit-lifecycle/criterion-0.finding: Native helper source rechecks current ancestry/enabled/visibility and selects eligible origin/fallback; linked completed/removed-origin units assert request target identity. This establishes the helper's bounded restoration decision, not actual completion wiring or focus delivery.
tvos-uikit-lifecycle/criterion-0.nextAction: Reuse existing helper receipts; map additional existing no-target/disabled/foreign-target assertions and separately review dismissal integration.

tvos-uikit-lifecycle/criterion-1.finding: Direct helper units reject old completion and duplicate invocation and preserve a reentrantly started new session. Source consumes active ownership before invoking external request code.
tvos-uikit-lifecycle/criterion-1.nextAction: Reuse these assertions and the stale-completion negative witness; review any proposed coordinator for overlapping mutation without claiming the helper tested a generated answer.

tvos-uikit-lifecycle/criterion-2.finding: Observed effects are injected request/target configuration, not delivered remote or VoiceOver focus.
tvos-uikit-lifecycle/criterion-2.nextAction: Preserve request-only claims and separately recorded SDK/runtime evidence; no UI/manual gate.

tvos-swiftui-actions/criterion-0.finding: Document-state selection/deletion units preserve operation identity and once-only deletion. They do not execute the installed ordinary and accessibility Button closures in generated SwiftUI semantics.
tvos-swiftui-actions/criterion-0.nextAction: Review compiled DocumentExample wiring for both paths and accept equivalent stable dispatch; do not inflate state tests into traversal evidence.

tvos-swiftui-actions/criterion-1.finding: A retained model action is invalidated by revision change. This is one per-binding strategy, not proof of enabled-state behavior or a requirement to reject a valid permanent current-owner dispatcher.
tvos-swiftui-actions/criterion-1.nextAction: Reuse current tests, inspect enabled-state composition and calibrate the resolved stable-dispatcher alternative.

tvos-swiftui-actions/criterion-2.finding: Native BridgeOwner replaces callbacks and prevents old native-view dispatch. That does not by itself establish repeated SwiftUI action installation or lifetime of the complete row.
tvos-swiftui-actions/criterion-2.nextAction: Map source composition and direct callback multiplicity/lifetime separately; the testing note is controller policy here.

tvos-swiftui-structure/criterion-0.finding: DocumentExample compiles .contain with separate article/Delete Buttons, but there is no bound assertion for the requested heading/balance/Open/Details composition. Compilation does not establish generated child navigation.
tvos-swiftui-structure/criterion-0.nextAction: Reuse compiled composition and tvOS declaration card; review an exact descriptive-subgroup/independent-control source contract, accepting optional rotor omission.

tvos-swiftui-structure/criterion-1.finding: Model units assert landmark subset, stable selection across reorder and clearing on removal. They do not exercise Open/Details handlers or prove a semantically useful generated landmark.
tvos-swiftui-structure/criterion-1.nextAction: Cross-link ordinary-action source and stable report identities while keeping landmark meaningfulness an independent review judgment.

tvos-swiftui-structure/criterion-2.finding: State/compiled modifiers cannot prove generated traversal, speech or focus delivery; the non-testing row did not receive the testing note.
tvos-swiftui-structure/criterion-2.nextAction: Apply controller evidence limits without requiring an unread note or new UI/manual validation.

tvos-swiftui-testing/criterion-0.finding: The exact question asks whether compile/extracted-state passes establish speech/rotor behavior. They do not establish those unasserted outcomes under project policy.
tvos-swiftui-testing/criterion-0.nextAction: Reuse testing-family correct/overclaim/ungradable calibration and avoid a native run for this reasoning control.

tvos-swiftui-testing/criterion-1.finding: Preserving first failures and distinguishing accidental/oracle/harness/mutant failures is controller policy with no required new accessibility unit.
tvos-swiftui-testing/criterion-1.nextAction: Review historical first/repair records and grading examples; never count compiler or simulator failure as an intended mutant rejection.

tvos-swiftui-testing/criterion-2.finding: Imports/annotations and exact environment provenance must be checked rather than inferred. Newer SDK compilation is not an observed tvOS deployment-target runtime.
tvos-swiftui-testing/criterion-2.nextAction: Use existing Mac declaration and receipt environment captures; leave unavailable source/runtime evidence explicit.

tvos-swiftui-testing/criterion-3.finding: Compile/unit-only scope is part of the question, not a generic claim that all accessibility can be proven by units.
tvos-swiftui-testing/criterion-3.nextAction: Calibrate a useful bounded plan and reject unsupported outcome claims without adding UI/manual prerequisites.

ios-uikit-no-change/criterion-0.finding: Working UISwitch naming/state is given as a task premise; default-behavior claims still require UIKit-specific source scope rather than another framework's rules.
ios-uikit-no-change/criterion-0.nextAction: Reuse accepted control contract and preservation calibration; verify any added API claim separately.

ios-uikit-no-change/criterion-1.finding: No defect is reported and ordinary behavior works. Replacing the native control is not required by the task.
ios-uikit-no-change/criterion-1.nextAction: Accept no-change and optional bounded advice; do not require a reference fix or mutation suite for a reasoning control.

ios-uikit-no-change/criterion-2.finding: Reference-free C1 supplies no reference-file reads. Naming a document or planning lookup is not evidence that it was read.
ios-uikit-no-change/criterion-2.nextAction: Audit actual captured context/read traces when available; accept an honest no-read statement.

ios-swiftui-no-change/criterion-0.finding: The question supplies a correctly bound standard Toggle. It does not demonstrate a need for custom role or label or justify universal spoken-output claims.
ios-swiftui-no-change/criterion-0.nextAction: Reuse framework-specific source review and preserve an explicit no-defect premise.

ios-swiftui-no-change/criterion-1.finding: The existing Toggle and binding should remain; no replacement is needed to satisfy this control.
ios-swiftui-no-change/criterion-1.nextAction: Reuse accepted control alternatives and distinguish optional comments from required changes.

ios-swiftui-no-change/criterion-2.finding: No source reads occurred merely because a candidate instruction named references. C1 provenance must stay separate from inline C2 material.
ios-swiftui-no-change/criterion-2.nextAction: Use actual read/supplied-context evidence; do not penalize an answer for declining to claim an unavailable read.

macos-appkit-no-change/criterion-0.finding: Correct NSButton title/enabled/current target/action are task premises. AppKit roles/children require AppKit reasoning rather than a UIKit container flag shortcut.
macos-appkit-no-change/criterion-0.nextAction: Retain accepted control interpretation and calibrate platform-specific alternatives.

macos-appkit-no-change/criterion-1.finding: Replacing the correctly configured standard NSButton is unnecessary on the supplied evidence.
macos-appkit-no-change/criterion-1.nextAction: Accept preservation with bounded explanation and optional advice; do not create an invented defect.

macos-appkit-no-change/criterion-2.finding: Reference-free control does not establish a source read or current SDK verification.
macos-appkit-no-change/criterion-2.nextAction: Compare any read claim with actual context/retrieval records, not reference names.

mixed-macos-owner/criterion-0.finding: The owner of grouping is explicitly unknown. Asking for the owning SwiftUI/AppKit/coordinator code or giving conditional advice satisfies the task.
mixed-macos-owner/criterion-0.nextAction: Preserve accepted conditional alternatives; use the existing ownership-family calibration before any model comparison.

mixed-macos-owner/criterion-1.finding: Limited information does not establish which layer is defective. In particular an AppKit isAccessibilityElement Boolean alone does not settle role/child behavior.
mixed-macos-owner/criterion-1.nextAction: Prioritize a valid AppKit parent-role/children counterexample in calibration; keep the observed Gemini overgeneralization as development evidence.

mixed-macos-owner/criterion-2.finding: Asking for code/source differs from claiming it was read. The unavailable ownership layer cannot be treated as inspected evidence.
mixed-macos-owner/criterion-2.nextAction: Accept honest conditional guidance and verify any read claim against retained inputs.

ios-missing-reference/criterion-0.finding: The file is explicitly unavailable. General advice must not be attributed to its exact unseen API contract.
ios-missing-reference/criterion-0.nextAction: Reuse unavailable-reference calibration with a correctly bounded response and fabricated-attribution defect.

ios-missing-reference/criterion-1.finding: No file contents were supplied or read. The answer can identify needed contents or a primary declaration without guessing the missing claim.
ios-missing-reference/criterion-1.nextAction: Retain accepted control and explicit missing-evidence disposition; no source retrieval or model run needed to preserve the test.

ios-missing-reference/criterion-2.finding: A planned lookup and a named local path do not prove retrieval. This criterion overlaps but is distinct from exact-claim attribution.
ios-missing-reference/criterion-2.nextAction: Reuse captured context and calibrate the read-claim gate independently; avoid counting paraphrases as new independent scenarios.

tvos-version-boundary/criterion-0.finding: Compiling on a newer SDK establishes neither execution on the deployment target nor a system-settings feature there.
tvos-version-boundary/criterion-0.nextAction: Reuse accepted version-boundary contract and recorded compile/runtime distinctions.

tvos-version-boundary/criterion-1.finding: A source introduction/availability statement or actual runtime record is needed for the exact feature claim; test-anchor labels alone are insufficient.
tvos-version-boundary/criterion-1.nextAction: Ask Mac only for missing existing availability/runtime source evidence; do not guess a version boundary or boot a new runtime.

tvos-version-boundary/criterion-2.finding: The answer must not claim a declaration/reference read from a named but unread path.
tvos-version-boundary/criterion-2.nextAction: Audit retained reads/supplied bytes; preserve honest unknowns and conditional guidance.

reuseCandidates.scope: Actual fixture-backed store phases; source/criterion mapping still needs independent review.
Actual player item and generation ownership; external changes still require the documented reload owner.
